label: Написанный
description: A 10-sentence card for написанный, the past passive participle of написать, with its short form написан.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative long form. Написанный comes from the perfective написать — the stem написа- plus the suffix -нн- and an adjective ending. The long form agrees with masculine текст.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative long form. The long participle takes -ая to agree with статья. Написанная статья equals статья, которую написали — the article that someone wrote.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative long form. Написанное carries the neuter ending -ое to match письмо. The -нн- suffix marks the finished result — the letter that was written.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative long form. The plural ending -ые lets написанные agree with буквы. It picks out the letters that were written with a pen.
Strategic focus: Neuter short form with быть. The short form написано joins было to build a past passive: письмо было написано. It reports when the letter was written.
Strategic focus: Feminine short form. The short predicative form написана agrees only in feminine gender with книга, and писателем in the instrumental names the agent who wrote it.
Strategic focus: Plural short form. The plural short form написаны agrees with письма and predicates the result with быть understood. The letters are all written.
Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental long form. After горжусь the noun книгой stands in the instrumental, and написанной takes the matching feminine instrumental ending to agree with it.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о написанном недавно романе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional long form. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so романе and написанном take prepositional endings and agree as the novel that was written.

missions.phrase: Я читаю написанную поэтом поэму внимательно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine accusative long form. With the object поэму the participle takes the accusative -ую, so написанную matches it in gender, number and case as the poem that was written.
